    Plenio¶

    "Either we die in glory or live to see another day under honor." — Plenio, at the entrance to Dragonreach

    Plenio was an elven adventurer who, alongside Diana and Korvald, encountered Julian the Dragon Tamer on the road from the Lyrical Forest to Dragonreach in 528 BGD.

    The Journey¶

    Plenio and his companions initially didn't believe Julian's story — that a talking tree had told him to go to Dragonreach to find his murdered family. They joked about his situation but kept following, curious to see how he would meet his end.

    At the entrance to Dragonreach, they asked: "You really want to do this?" Julian said yes and moved forward alone.

    After a pause, Plenio spoke for all three: "Either we die in glory or live to see another day under honor." They followed him in.

    The Duel¶

    Inside Dragonreach, Fireborn appeared and challenged Julian to the Unjust Duel. Plenio, Diana, and Korvald hid in a cave, watching. After the ten-hour fight — when Julian reached one centimeter from Fireborn's core of life — Fireborn summoned them out and demanded they swear loyalty to Julian or die. They swore.

    The Rebellion¶

    After Julian received the Sword of Xi and left Dragonreach, Plenio, Diana, and Korvald instigated the population to rise against Baoth and Dragon King Goldenborn. They led guerrilla warfare across the region, eventually settling in what became Northaxeland, where the population was most in favor of their cause.

    Entire cities raised armies. Some declared independence from Baoth. Shuttil — Julian's birthplace, by then allied to Baoth — was the first to fall.

    Legacy¶

    Plenio, Diana, and Korvald became loyal servants of the Axel people, guiding them into the future. They helped formalize the Alegoria religion under Julian's legend and remained in Northaxeland for the rest of their lives.
